reviews.review_title: Thoughts on many aspects of the game
reviews.review_description:
First of all I just want to congratulate the owners on their first week of bonobo’s release and how cool some of the updates their working on seem, second I’m just gonna say, the fan base is already amazing and I’m excited to see what comes next. The amazing fanart shows dedication and passion for this game project and the thankfulness given to it.
Third positive note is that the monster jumpscares and the map look great and I’m excited to see what other stuff comes.
Now. Into bugs and glitches. First of all, the shop is glitchy and I keep going into the floor and barely being able to move once I cross the first half of the floor, lastly, the cosmetic glitch (I asked them about this and they said it won’t fix) but I won’t really say a lot about it because I don’t mind. So all in all an amazing game and I would approve it as a well made co-op horror game based on gorilla tag, scary baboon, lethal ape and more. Thanks jetto, Tristan and the whole dev team for this game.
